name: prompt-manager.skill-set-read
purpose: Read one scenario's skill set as prompt-manager's registry sees it: ids registered under the scenario pack, usage and improve presence, token size, and read counts when skill-usage answers.

scenario.description: Scenario whose skill set is read.

usage_id.description: Declared usage skill id; defaults to <scenario>.

improve_id.description: Declared improve skill id; defaults to <scenario>-improve.

feature_ids.description: Pipe-separated declared feature skill ids; empty means none.

assumptions: prompt-manager is running and its skill bindings are reachable from the kernel
the skill-usage binding returns 500 on the unknown proto field `projected` as of 2026-09-02; the read-counts row reads unreliable:proto_drift_skill_usage (class binding_error) until that is fixed
an unavailable row is unknown, never zero

a row with a permanent reason (no_governed_binding, kernel_invoke_budget, read_elsewhere, pending_telemetry) never lowers the status; only a transient scenario_unreachable row or a failed read makes the board partial
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
at most 50 registry rows per filter are read with head
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason}: registered-under-scenario-pack, usage-id-present, improve-id-present, set-token-size, read-counts; target and in_band are null (pure reads); reason is the closed vocabulary of program-contracts.md
signals.unavailable: count of rows not readable in-program (permanent and transient)
signals.registered: skill ids the registry attributes to the scenario
signals.usage_present: true when the declared or conventional usage id is registered
signals.improve_present: true when the declared or conventional improve id is registered

outputs.evidence: sensor command names, one per row

fixtures.note: ok is the status this board should produce; partial is accepted only for the read-counts row, which is a failed read (unreliable:proto_drift_skill_usage) until the skill-usage binding stops 500ing on the proto field `projected`.
Pins stable public plan skill names while their authoritative sources remain Plan Manager-owned.
